export const meta = {
  name: 'phase-b-webhook-tests-ui',
  description: 'T7 gateway bills + webhook, T8 concurrency/webhook tests, T9 contract tests, T10 route authz tests, REVIEW.md check; then T11/T12 UI; per-item verify with fixer rounds',
  phases: [
    { title: 'Implement', detail: 'T7 backend, T8/T9/T10 tests, T13 review check' },
    { title: 'Verify', detail: 'reviewer + skeptic on T7, fixer rounds' },
    { title: 'UI', detail: 'T11 staff/manager, T12 tenant (after T7+T8)' },
  ],
}

const COMMON = `You are a lane in a timed build (lead = the main session). Working directory: ./app. Kit files: ../BRIEF.md (assessment brief, source of truth), ../SPEC.md (Contracts, Error contract, Domain rules, Integration contracts), ../DECISIONS.md (cite D-ids in comments).
OVERRIDES — the brief wins over CLAUDE.md and your agent file: error body { "error": "message" }; NO required idempotency key (optional Idempotency-Key header, D9); NO webhook_events table and NO 5-minute replay window — webhook idempotency is the bill state machine under the bill FOR UPDATE lock + UNIQUE payments.gateway_bill_id (D10); bigint sen in SQL, number in TS; invoice status computed with invoiceStatus, never stored; seed = npm run seed; env file .env.local (GATEWAY_X_SIGNATURE_KEY=test_x_signature_key locally); timezone fixed Asia/Kuala_Lumpur.
What exists (committed): migrations supabase/migrations/20261026000001_schema.sql and 20261026000002_money.sql (private.create_gateway_bill(p_actor_id, p_lease_id, p_as_of) returns (id, amount_sen); private.apply_gateway_callback(p_bill_id, p_paid, p_paid_amount_sen, p_paid_at, p_transaction_id, p_transaction_status) returns (outcome 'paid'|'duplicate'|'failed'|'ignored', payment_id); SQLSTATEs P0400/P0404/P0409/P0422), src/lib/{billing,money,dates,errors,prisma}.ts, src/lib/supabase/{server,browser,admin,admin-client}.ts, src/server/{auth,access,http}.ts, src/server/services/{leases,payments,reports,serialize}.ts, routes under src/app/api/{leases,payments,reports}, scripts/seed.ts, tests/helpers/** (read tests/helpers/README.md: createFixtureOrg, SEEDED, signIn, ctxFor, api, gateway.ts signedCallback, db/newConnection), tests/{unit,rls,db,storage}. The DB is seeded with the brief's data (password RentDemo#2026); dev server runs at http://127.0.0.1:3000 with hot reload (never start/kill it).
Rules: edit ONLY your listed files; one simple command per Bash call; never npm i; never commit; never db reset (only where your task says so); DB/test commands via bash ../scripts/with-db.sh <cmd>; tests create their own fixture orgs and must not change the seeded brief data except where stated. Put every choice SPEC.md does not fix under assumptions.`

const IMPL = { type: 'object', properties: {
  task: { type: 'string' }, status: { type: 'string', enum: ['done', 'partial', 'blocked'] },
  files_changed: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } }, tests_added: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
  checks_run: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } }, assumptions: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
  findings: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'real bugs found in code you do not own: file:line, scenario, expected vs actual' },
  notes: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['task', 'status', 'files_changed', 'checks_run', 'assumptions'] }
const REVIEW = { type: 'object', properties: {
  verdict: { type: 'string', enum: ['PASS', 'FAIL'] },
  findings: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: {
    severity: { type: 'string', enum: ['blocker', 'major', 'minor'] }, file: { type: 'string' }, line: { type: 'string' },
    problem: { type: 'string' }, scenario: { type: 'string' }, fix: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['severity', 'file', 'problem', 'fix'] } } },
  required: ['verdict', 'findings'] }
const SKEPTIC = { type: 'object', properties: {
  refuted: { type: 'boolean' },
  findings: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: {
    rule: { type: 'string' }, file: { type: 'string' }, line: { type: 'string' }, scenario: { type: 'string' }, fix: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['rule', 'scenario', 'fix'] } } },
  required: ['refuted', 'findings'] }
const REVIEWMD = { type: 'object', properties: {
  items: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: {
    number: { type: 'integer' }, verdict: { type: 'string', enum: ['real', 'false_positive', 'overstated', 'needs_rewording'] },
    reason: { type: 'string' }, suggested_text: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['number', 'verdict', 'reason'] } },
  missed: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: { lines: { type: 'string' }, problem: { type: 'string' }, scenario: { type: 'string' }, severity: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['lines', 'problem', 'scenario'] } },
  suspicious_but_correct_check: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['items', 'missed'] }

let used = 0
const run = (p, o) => { used++; return agent(p, o) }

const T7 = { id: 'T7', agentType: 'backend-engineer',
  files: 'src/server/services/gateway.ts, src/server/services/webhook.ts, src/app/api/leases/[leaseId]/gateway-bills/route.ts, src/app/api/gateway-bills/[billId]/route.ts, src/app/api/webhooks/gateway/route.ts, scripts/seed.ts (freshness check only), src/lib/** and src/server/** for fixes you need',
  prompt: `Task T7 (BOARD row T7) — R30-R35. Implement:
1. src/server/services/gateway.ts:
 - createGatewayBill(ctx, leaseId, asOf = new Date()) — loadCaller; requireLeaseAccess(caller, leaseId, ['tenant']) (staff/manager of the org -> 403 'Only the lease tenant can pay online'; others -> 404); call private.create_gateway_bill(ctx.userId, leaseId, asOf::timestamptz) via typed $queryRaw (wrapped in withRetry); returns { billId, amountSen } (number via toSen). P0422 'Nothing is due' -> 422.
 - getGatewayBill(ctx, billId) — for the /payments/return page and UI: malformed/unknown -> 404; visible to the bill's lease tenant and to staff/manager of its org (else 404); returns { billId, leaseId, amountSen, status }. READ ONLY — it must never change anything (R31; settling via the return page is an instant fail).
 - Routes: POST /api/leases/[leaseId]/gateway-bills -> 201 { billId, amountSen } (401 first; no body needed — ignore/allow an empty body); GET /api/gateway-bills/[billId] -> 200.
2. src/server/services/webhook.ts handleGatewayCallback(rawBody: string, contentType: string | null): Promise<{ status: number; body: unknown }> and src/app/api/webhooks/gateway/route.ts (POST; reads await req.text(); never uses formData; not behind auth; proxy matcher already excludes /api/webhooks):
 - Parse with new URLSearchParams(rawBody). If any key appears twice -> 401 (the signature is ambiguous). x_signature missing or not ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ -> 401 { error: 'Invalid signature' }.
 - Source = every field EXCEPT x_signature (including unknown extra fields — the gateway may add fields), sorted by key ascending by character code (plain JS sort on keys, NOT localeCompare), each key immediately followed by its value, joined with '|'; HMAC-SHA256 hex with process.env.GATEWAY_X_SIGNATURE_KEY (missing key -> 500 generic, logged as 'gateway key not configured'); compare with crypto.timingSafeEqual on the two 32-byte buffers. Mismatch -> 401. Verify against the brief's test vector (key test_x_signature_key, six fields -> 06994fab2d674e7829144eaa2204631716d3c099b503d38945e92b6296531641) in your checks.
 - After a valid signature: id not a uuid -> 404 { error: 'Unknown bill' } (bill ids are uuids, so 'bill_8f3a2c' is simply unknown). paid must be exactly 'true' or 'false' else 400. For paid=true: paid_amount must match ^\\d+$ and be a safe integer else 400; paid_at must match ^(\\d{4})-(\\d{2})-(\\d{2}) (\\d{2}):(\\d{2}):(\\d{2}) ([+-])(\\d{2})(\\d{2})$ and be a real date -> converted to an ISO instant with that offset, else 400. For paid=false, paid_amount/paid_at are not required (parse paid_at if valid, else null).
 - Call private.apply_gateway_callback(bill, paid, paid_amount, paid_at, transaction_id, transaction_status) in ONE call (it locks the bill FOR UPDATE, then the lease; it enforces amount mismatch 422, unknown 404, at most one payment). Outcome paid/duplicate/failed/ignored -> 200 { ok: true, outcome }. Errors via toErrorResponse semantics (P0404 404, P0422 422, P0400 400).
 - Logging (R35): log ONLY the bill id and the outcome or the error class, e.g. console.info('gateway callback', { billId, outcome }). Never log the key, the signature, the raw body or the parsed fields.
 - Order of checks exactly as the brief table: 401 signature first, then 404 unknown bill, then 422 amount mismatch, then the state machine.
4. Panel minors (hard stop b): src/server/services/reports.ts MAX_MONTHS 120 -> 1200 (D49, still bounds generate_series); src/lib/dates.ts: stop duplicating daysInMonth / leap-year / MYT offset — export them from src/lib/billing.ts (billing.ts must still import nothing) and import them in dates.ts. Re-run npx vitest run tests/unit afterwards (must pass).
3. scripts/seed.ts freshness check (D48): refuse (exit 1 'Database is not fresh: run npx supabase db reset first') only when an organization named 'Northwind Properties' or 'Beta Realty' already exists, so leftover test fixture orgs do not block a re-seed. Do NOT run the seed or reset the DB.
Done means: tsc + eslint clean (show output); curl probes against http://127.0.0.1:3000: (a) sign in aisyah@northwind.test (POST http://127.0.0.1:54321/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password, apikey = NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY from .env.local, JSON body; password RentDemo#2026) and POST /api/leases/<her lease id>/gateway-bills -> 201 with the amount due now (all her invoices due on or before today MYT minus allocations); then fire the brief's simulator: run "node gateway-sim.mjs <billId> <amountSen> true" with env GATEWAY_X_SIGNATURE_KEY=test_x_signature_key (use: env GATEWAY_X_SIGNATURE_KEY=test_x_signature_key node gateway-sim.mjs <billId> <amount> true) -> 200; run it again -> 200 duplicate; then GET /api/leases/<lease> as aisyah shows one online payment allocated; (b) a forged signature -> 401; (c) unknown uuid bill -> 404; (d) wrong amount -> 422; (e) staff POST gateway-bills on Aisyah's lease -> 403; Ben's token on Aisyah's lease -> 404. NOTE: these probes add one online payment to Aisyah's lease in the seeded DB — that is allowed; report it.`,
}

const T8 = { id: 'T8', agentType: 'test-concurrency',
  files: 'tests/concurrency/**, tests/webhook/**',
  prompt: `Task T8 (BOARD row T8) — R22, R23, R28, R30, R34, R35, R46. Write tests (describe names start with the R-numbers) using fixture orgs from tests/helpers (createFixtureOrg gives manager/staff/tenant tokens and a lease with invoices; read tests/helpers/README.md; ask via findings if you need a helper — do not edit helpers).
tests/concurrency/payments.test.ts (over HTTP with the api() helper, real concurrency with Promise.all; repeat each race ≥ 5 times):
 - R28 two staff recording at the same moment on a lease with remaining X: amounts a+b > X, a<=X, b<=X -> exactly one 201 and one 422; Σ pending never exceeds the cap (brief example: RM 800 + RM 700 on RM 1,000 remaining).
 - 10 concurrent manager payments of size X/4 -> exactly 4 succeed, allocations sum exactly X, no invoice over-allocated (check via pg: Σ allocations per invoice <= amount).
 - R23/R28 approve twice at the same moment -> one 200 { status: 'approved' }, one 409; allocations inserted once (count rows via pg).
 - approve vs void/reject race on the same pending payment -> consistent final state, never both.
 - approve re-check: staff pending payment, then the balance is consumed by an online payment (create a bill as the tenant via POST /api/leases/:id/gateway-bills and settle it with a signed callback) -> approve -> 422, payment stays pending_verification.
 - R46 two POST /api/leases on the same unit with overlapping dates at the same moment -> one 201, one 409; adjacent leases (end + 1 day) both 201; a lease ending on the day another starts -> 409 (both inclusive).
 - optional Idempotency-Key header (D9): same key + same body twice concurrently -> same id, one row; same key + different body -> 409; invalid key -> 400.
tests/webhook/gateway.test.ts (use tests/helpers/gateway.ts signedCallback/gatewaySignature; POST form-urlencoded to /api/webhooks/gateway):
 - brief test vector reproduces 06994fab2d674e7829144eaa2204631716d3c099b503d38945e92b6296531641 with key test_x_signature_key.
 - every row of the brief's table: missing signature 401, wrong signature 401, signature over different field values 401, unknown bill (random uuid) 404 and 'bill_8f3a2c' 404, paid=true wrong amount 422 (no effect: bill still pending, no payment), paid=true pending -> 200 + bill paid + exactly one approved online payment with received_at = paid_at (check exact instant via pg) + allocated in order, repeat -> 200 no new payment, paid=false pending -> 200 bill failed, repeat -> 200, paid=false after paid -> 200 bill stays paid, paid=true after failed -> 200 paid + one payment.
 - 10 identical paid=true callbacks at the same moment -> all 200 (or 200s) and exactly ONE payment row for the bill; mixed concurrent paid=true and paid=false -> final state paid with one payment, or failed then later paid — never two payments, never paid -> failed.
 - extra unknown field included in the signature -> 200 accepted; extra field NOT in the signature -> 401.
 - unapplied: tenant creates a bill, then a manager pays the same invoices by cash, then the callback arrives -> 200, payment approved with unapplied_sen = bill amount (nothing left to allocate) — captured money is never rejected.
 - gateway bill creation: tenant on a lease with something due -> 201 { billId (uuid), amountSen = Σ unpaid of invoices due on or before today MYT }; a fixture lease starting in the future (nothing due) -> 422; staff -> 403; other tenant -> 404; two bills ids are different and uuid v4.
The webhook and gateway-bills routes are being built in parallel by backend-engineer (T7): write the tests now from the brief and this contract, then wait until src/app/api/webhooks/gateway/route.ts and src/app/api/leases/[leaseId]/gateway-bills/route.ts exist and respond (check with curl; if not, run "sleep 60" and check again, up to 30 times), then run them.
Done means: bash ../scripts/with-db.sh npx vitest run tests/concurrency tests/webhook — run twice (races must be stable); report pass/fail. A failure caused by an app bug goes into findings (file, scenario, expected, actual) — never weaken the test.`,
}

const T9 = { id: 'T9', agentType: 'test-engineer',
  files: 'tests/contract/**, tests/unit/errors.test.ts, tests/setup/** (global seed guard only), tests/helpers/** (additive only, keep signatures)',
  prompt: `Task T9 (BOARD row T9) — R5, R7-R9, R29, R45.
1. tests/setup/global.ts: after the server check, if the seeded account manager@northwind.test does not exist (check auth.users via pg), run npm run seed once (spawn 'npm', ['run','seed'], wait, fail setup if it exits non-zero) — so the fast gate (which resets the DB, then runs tests) has the seeded data. The seed refuses only when the brief orgs exist (D48, being changed by backend T7 in parallel).
2. tests/contract/*.test.ts — one describe per route (R-numbers first): exact status codes and zod-validated bodies for every route in ../SPEC.md Contracts: POST /api/leases (201 { id } exact keys; invoices stored == generateSchedule; audit lease.created row; 400 bad body / unknown keys / bad dates / end<start; 409 overlap), GET /api/leases/:leaseId (exact shape, invoices in allocation order, statuses == invoiceStatus(now)), POST /api/leases/:leaseId/payments (201 { id, status } manager approved / staff pending_verification; 400 missing fields, method 'online', receivedAt without offset, cash with slipPath, bank_transfer without slip, slip not found; 422 over cap; cap includes pending), approve/reject/void (200 { status }; 409 not pending / not approved; 400 reason < 5 chars or missing; void removes only that payment's allocations), GET /api/reports/collections (seed: Northwind 2026-01..2026-03 exactly [300000, 0, 200000]; 400 for from>to, 2026-13, 2026-1, missing params; one entry per month in order). Every error body is exactly { error: string }. Write tests that mutate on FIXTURE orgs only; seeded-data tests are read-only, EXCEPT that you must not assume Aisyah's lease has only the 2 seeded payments (T7 probes may add an online payment) — assert the seeded payments by id/method instead of total counts.
3. Seed facts (R7-R9): via pg — 2 brief orgs, 7 accounts with the right roles (memberships for manager/staff, tenants.user_id for tenants), units incl. D-03-2 with no lease, 4 leases with the brief's dates/rent/deposit, invoices == generateSchedule for each, Aisyah's cash 300000 received 2026-01-31T02:00:00Z approved by the manager and bank transfer 200000 received 2026-02-28T16:30:00Z with an existing slip object in the Northwind folder, approved; audit rows for lease.created ×4 and payment.approved.
4. tests/unit/errors.test.ts: toErrorResponse mapping for P0400/P0404/P0409/P0422/23P01/23505/22P02/40001 raised through prisma.$queryRawUnsafe (real DB, e.g. select private... or a do block raising) and ZodError/ApiError/unknown -> 500 { error: 'Internal error' }; withRetry retries at most once.
Done means: bash ../scripts/with-db.sh npx vitest run tests/contract tests/unit passes (show summary). App bugs -> findings, never weaken.`,
}

const T10 = { id: 'T10', agentType: 'test-authz',
  files: 'tests/authz/**',
  prompt: `Task T10 (BOARD row T10) — R36-R41. tests/authz/routes.test.ts (+ more files if useful): for EVERY route (POST /api/leases, GET /api/leases, GET /api/leases/:leaseId, POST /api/leases/:leaseId/payments, POST /api/payments/:paymentId/approve|reject|void, GET /api/payments/:paymentId/slip, POST /api/leases/:leaseId/gateway-bills, GET /api/gateway-bills/:billId, GET /api/reports/collections), use both seeded accounts (read-only probes on the seeded data: Northwind manager/staff, aisyah, ben, probe, Beta manager, chen) and fixture orgs for anything that mutates:
 - no token -> 401 JSON { error } (redirect: 'manual', never 3xx/HTML); garbage Bearer token -> 401; valid session cookie (build the sb-127-auth-token cookie the way @supabase/ssr does, see REFERENCE.md: sb-127-auth-token=base64-<base64url(JSON session)>) works like Bearer.
 - other org's record (Beta manager on Northwind lease/payment/bill; chen on Northwind lease) -> 404 with no data; other tenant's lease in the same org (ben on aisyah's) -> 404; malformed id ('abc', '1') -> 404; nonexistent uuid -> 404.
 - visible but wrong role -> 403: tenant POST payments on own lease, tenant approve/reject/void own-lease payment, staff approve/reject/void, staff/tenant POST /api/leases, tenant GET collections, staff/manager POST gateway-bills, tenant GET slip.
 - R39 body ids: manager POST /api/leases with another org's unitId or tenantId -> 404 and no lease created; extra keys (orgId, status, org_id) -> 400 (zod strict); slipPath pointing to another org's folder -> 400 and nothing recorded.
 - R37 escalation: a tenant sets user_metadata.role='manager' via supabase.auth.updateUser, gets a fresh token, then POST /api/leases and approve -> still 403/404.
 - R41: grep the built client bundle is the lead's job; you assert no route response ever contains the secret key string or a stack trace ('at ' frames / 'prisma' / SQL text) — check the 500-path by sending a body that passes validation but is odd if you can find one; otherwise skip that.
Done means: bash ../scripts/with-db.sh npx vitest run tests/authz passes (show summary). Routes T7 is building in parallel (gateway-bills, gateway-bills/:billId): wait until they exist (curl; sleep 60 between checks, up to 30) before running those cases. App bugs -> findings, never weaken.`,
}

const T13 = { id: 'T13', agentType: 'reviewer',
  prompt: `${COMMON}
Task T13 — independent false-positive check of Part B. Read the PR listing in ../BRIEF.md ("Part B - Code Review", lines 1-111 of the listing) and app REVIEW.md. The brief says "Report only real problems: every false positive costs points" and gives the assumptions: the brief's rules apply, prisma connects as the database owner, createClient() returns a Supabase server client for the current request, allocate(tx, paymentId) is correct. For EACH numbered finding in REVIEW.md decide real / false_positive / overstated / needs_rewording with a reason (check the scenario concretely, e.g. Prisma lazy PrismaPromise semantics, Postgres session timezone, Next server action exposure, Date.parse of date-only strings). Also list real problems REVIEW.md missed (line, scenario), and check the "Looks suspicious but is correct" section for anything that is actually wrong. Read-only.`,
}

const UI11 = { id: 'T11', agentType: 'ui-builder',
  files: 'src/app/(app)/dashboard/**, src/app/(app)/leases/**, src/components/staff/**, src/components/ui/** (npx shadcn add only — you are the only lane allowed to add shadcn components)',
  prompt: `Task T11 (BOARD row T11) — R49, R50, R52, D26, D28. Staff/manager UI with shadcn/ui + Tailwind under the existing (app) route group (read src/app/(app)/layout.tsx, src/components/app-shell/**). Server components read through the services (src/server/services/*.ts with ctx { userId } from the cookie session via src/server/auth.ts getUserId()); client components mutate by fetch() to the REST routes (same-origin cookie session) — no server actions (D28). Every action shows a toast (sonner) for success AND error (show the API's { error } message); loading states (Skeleton / disabled buttons with spinner text), helpful empty states and inline validation messages. TypeScript strict, no any.
 - /dashboard: number of overdue invoices (overdueCount(ctx, new Date())) and the collections report for the last 6 months including the current MYT month (collectionsReport; month labels like 'May 2026'; amounts with formatSen). Tenants hitting /dashboard -> redirect to /tenant; unauthenticated handled by the layout.
 - /leases: list (listLeases) with unit, tenant, dates, rent; link to /leases/[leaseId]. (Bonus if quick: ?q= search on unit/tenant server-side.)
 - /leases/[leaseId]: getLease — invoices table (period 'YYYY-MM-DD – YYYY-MM-DD' or 'Deposit', due date, amount, paid, status Badge), payments table (received at formatted in MYT with formatMytDisplay, method, amount, unapplied, status, and for bank transfers a 'View slip' button that GETs /api/payments/:id/slip and opens the signed URL).
 - Record payment form (client): amount typed in ringgit parsed with parseRinggitToSen from src/lib/billing.ts (show 'Enter an amount like 1,500.00' on error), method select cash/bank transfer, 'received at' as <input type="datetime-local"> interpreted as Malaysia time with mytLocalToIso (label it '(Malaysia time)'; default = now in MYT computed on the client after mount to avoid hydration mismatch), slip file input for bank transfer: validate JPEG/PNG/PDF and <= 5 MiB client-side, upload with the browser supabase client to bucket payment-slips at '<orgId>/<leaseId>/<crypto.randomUUID()>.<ext>' (orgId: pass from the server component — the lease's org id from the service or the caller's membership), then POST /api/leases/:leaseId/payments { amountSen, method, receivedAt, slipPath }; on failure the server deletes the slip; also try to remove it from the client on failure. After success router.refresh().
 - Manager-only actions (render only for managers, but the server enforces it anyway): Approve / Reject (reason ≥ 5 chars) for pending_verification; Void (AlertDialog confirmation + reason ≥ 5 chars) for approved. Each POSTs to /api/payments/:id/approve|reject|void.
 - Dates/times: ONLY formatMytDisplay / the stored YYYY-MM-DD strings; never toLocaleString without timeZone, never new Date() during server render that differs from the client — no hydration warnings.
Done means: tsc + eslint clean; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' on /dashboard, /leases and /leases/<id> without a cookie returns a redirect (307) or 200 login page — and with a manager session cookie returns 200 (build the cookie as REFERENCE.md describes, or just verify the routes compile via curl and report).`,
}

const UI12 = { id: 'T12', agentType: 'ui-builder',
  files: 'src/app/(app)/tenant/**, src/app/(app)/payments/return/**, src/components/tenant/**',
  prompt: `Task T12 (BOARD row T12) — R31, R51, R52. Tenant portal with shadcn/ui + Tailwind (use only the components already in src/components/ui — another lane adds components; if you need one it lacks, build it from existing ones). Per the brief, the tenant portal reads the tenant's own data and updates their phone number DIRECTLY FROM THE BROWSER with supabase-js (src/lib/supabase/browser.ts createClient), relying on RLS:
 - /tenant (client component page or a server shell + client component): loads own tenants row, leases (with unit name), invoices, payment_allocations, payments via supabase-js after mount (loading skeletons). For each lease: invoices table with paidSen = Σ allocations and status = invoiceStatus(...) from src/lib/billing.ts computed with new Date() on the client; payments table (received at with formatMytDisplay, method, amount, status); 'Amount due now' = Σ (amount − paid) over invoices with dueDate <= toMytDate(new Date()).
 - Pay now button (disabled with a message when nothing is due): POST /api/leases/:leaseId/gateway-bills (cookie session) -> show the new bill id and amount in a Card, with the simulator command 'node gateway-sim.mjs <billId> <amountSen> true' and a link to /payments/return?bill_id=<id>&paid=true; toast on 422 'Nothing is due' and other errors.
 - Edit phone: input + Save -> supabase.from('tenants').update({ phone }).eq('id', tenantId).select() ; toast success/error; validate format client-side (digits, spaces, dashes, optional leading +, 6-20 chars).
 - /payments/return (server component): reads bill_id from searchParams (await searchParams), loads the bill with getGatewayBill(ctx, billId) from src/server/services/gateway.ts (being built by T7 — wait until it exists: check, sleep 60, up to 30 times) and shows its REAL status from the DB (pending: 'We are waiting for the gateway to confirm your payment', paid, failed) — it ignores the paid query parameter and changes NOTHING (R31; settling from the return page is an instant fail). Unknown/other tenant's bill -> 'Bill not found'.
 - All dates/times in Malaysia time via formatMytDisplay / YYYY-MM-DD strings; data that depends on 'now' is computed only on the client after mount (no hydration warnings).
Done means: tsc + eslint clean; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:3000/tenant and /payments/return?bill_id=x return 200 or a login redirect.`,
}

const impl = (t, phase) => run(`${COMMON}\n\nFiles you may edit: ${t.files}\n\n${t.prompt}`,
  { agentType: t.agentType, label: `${t.id}:${t.agentType}`, phase, schema: IMPL })

const reviewT7 = (r) => run(`${COMMON}\n\nReview task T7 (gateway bills + webhook) read-only. Files: ${(r.files_changed || []).join(', ')}. items.reason: Correct. Every export of a 'use server' file is a POST endpoint. getCollections has no getUser(), no membership check, and takes orgId from the caller. Prisma runs as the table owner, so RLS does not apply. The brief (section 6) names Server Actions as endpoints that must check auth themselves. Critical is the right severity. The scenario is a bit weak, though: a Northwind tenant has no easy way to learn Beta's org uuid. A concrete version: the action id is the same for every user and ships in the client chunk any staff user downloads, and a Northwind tenant can read their own org id through the Data API (organizations, read own). So the tenant can call the action and read collections, which only staff and managers may see. Beta's manager can do the same with any Northwind org id they learn. Optional: reword the scenario.
items.suggested_text: Scenario: the action id is in the client bundle and is the same for every user. A Northwind tenant reads their own org id through the Data API (organizations: read own), calls the action with it, and gets Northwind's collections, which only staff and managers may read. Any caller who knows another org's id, such as Beta's manager, gets that org's numbers.

items.reason: Correct. A user can write their own raw_user_meta_data with supabase.auth.updateUser({ data }). The brief explicitly bans taking the role from user_metadata. The fix also covers the null-user case (currently 403 instead of 401). Critical is right.

Correct. findUnique by id alone, run as the owner, lets Beta's manager (or anyone who gets past item 2) charge fees on Northwind leases. 200 vs 404 reveals whether a lease exists. A non-uuid leaseId on a @db.Uuid column gives P2023 and an unhandled 500. Critical is right.

Correct. Line 77 reads the status outside the transaction with no lock. At READ COMMITTED, the second transaction's UPDATE on line 80 waits for the first one's row lock, then updates again because there is no status condition, and both create a payment. If the PR's schema already had UNIQUE(gateway_bill_id), the second delivery would instead fail with P2002 and return 500. Either way it breaks 'at most one payment, ever' or the 200 contract. The fix (lock or conditional UPDATE ... RETURNING, plus UNIQUE) is right.

Correct. The brief requires 422 with no effect when paid=true and paid_amount differs from the bill's amount. The code never compares them and uses the untrusted amount. Only signed callbacks get this far, so the risk is gateway-side mismatches rather than an attacker. High is fine because it is a broken contract that also creates wrong money.

Correct, and the scenario is concrete. On a 401 the log contains the HMAC that is valid for exactly those fields. Anyone who can read the logs sends forged fields, reads `expected` and replays them, which is a full signature bypass. It also breaks the brief's 'never log whole callback payloads'. The key itself is not logged, and the finding does not claim it is. High is fine; it could arguably be Critical.

Correct. Nothing stops a second run from charging the same invoice again. Line 29 already filters kind 'rent', so there are no fees on fees, but repeated calls stack 2% fees. Concurrent calls race as well. The fix (UNIQUE source invoice plus ON CONFLICT, inside one locked transaction) is right.

The diagnosis is right. date_trunc on a timestamptz and the date-to-timestamptz casts in the comparisons both use the session TimeZone, which is UTC on Supabase, so month boundaries fall at 08:00 MYT. The seeded transfer at 2026-03-01 00:30 MYT is 2026-02-28 16:30Z, so it lands in February. The 'from' and 'to' boundary scenarios are also correct. The stated result is wrong, though: this query cannot return a 0 entry, because empty months are dropped (item 9). The real output is two rows, 2026-01: 300000 and 2026-02: 200000, with no March row. Reword so the example matches what the listed code actually returns.

Correct. paid=false never moves a pending bill to failed (brief row 'paid=false, bill pending -> failed'). An unknown bill with paid=false returns 200 instead of 404, because line 73 runs before the lookup. A conditional pending->failed update keeps the rule that a paid bill never goes back.

Correct. The brief says received_at = paid_at. new Date() is the delivery time, so a retry after midnight on the last day of a month moves the payment into the wrong collections month. Medium is right.

Correct, and the Prisma detail is right. PrismaPromise is lazy, and `await nextReference()` runs while each argument object is built, before any create executes, which only happens when Promise.all calls .then. So every fee in one request reads the same 'last' invoice. With no $transaction, a unique violation leaves the creates that already ran committed and returns 500. Optional addition: orderBy createdAt is not the highest reference either. Invoices inserted in one transaction (lease creation) share now(), so findFirst picks an arbitrary one of them, and duplicates can occur even for a single sequential fee.

Correct. 149300/150000 = 0.99533 >= 0.995, so an invoice with RM 7.00 still unpaid gets no fee. The PR comment says 'still unpaid'. Float ratios on money also go against the brief's integer-sen rule. Comparing integers (paid >= amountSen) is the right fix.

Correct. A non-constant-time compare of the HMAC. In practice it is hard to exploit over a network, so Low is right. The fix rightly checks the length and hex format first, because timingSafeEqual throws on buffers of different lengths.

The arithmetic is right: unpaid*2/100 < 0.5 exactly when unpaid < 25, and Math.round(0.5)=1 at 25. But with line 31 as written, an invoice with < 25 sen unpaid only gets past the 0.995 threshold when its amount is under RM 50, for example a one-day prorated last period. For normal rent the case cannot happen. It becomes common once item 13 is fixed. Say so, so the scenario is reachable as stated.

t13.suspicious_but_correct_check: I checked all six claims and each one holds. Line 24: MYT is a fixed UTC+8 with no DST, so the date is exact whatever the server TZ. Lines 25/29: Date.parse of a date-only ISO string is UTC midnight (ECMAScript), which matches what Prisma returns for @db.Date. Date >= Date compares valueOf() numerically, so due 03-01 is skipped on 03-08 and charged on 03-09, as stated. Line 39: new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') is UTC midnight, and Prisma writes that calendar date. Line 30: the 0n seed is correct for BigInt columns. Line 32: x*2/100 only lands on .5 when x = 50k+25, which divides exactly in IEEE 754, so Math.round really is half-up here and the base is the outstanding amount. Line 62: the HMAC covers the same last-value-wins object, so it cannot be bypassed, and extra fields are signed. Three items could be added to this section. (a) Line 103: SUM(bigint) returns numeric, so Prisma returns a Decimal, not the declared bigint. With manager and staff session cookies (Supabase password grant, cookie sb-127-auth-token=base64-...): /dashboard, /leases, /leases?q=ben and /leases/<Aisyah lease> return 200. The rendered text was checked: overdue count, 6 month table May 2026 to October 2026, lease list, Aisyah's 7 invoices (Deposit and period ranges), payments in MYT ('31 Jan 2026, 10:00', '1 Mar 2026, 00:30'), a View slip button on the bank transfer, Void buttons for the manager.

assumptions: No shadcn components were added. The existing alert-dialog, select, table, badge, card, input, label, textarea, skeleton and sonner cover everything, so src/components/ui/** is untouched.

No loading.tsx files. A route-level loading.tsx flushes a 200 before the page runs, which turned the tenant redirect (307) and the cross-org 404 into 200 responses. The access check now runs first and the data sits inside a Suspense with a skeleton (src/components/staff/skeletons.tsx). The lease detail page has no skeleton so its 404 keeps the real status.

Role gate in pages: a user with no staff/manager membership and at least one tenant row is redirected to /tenant. A user with neither sees a 'No access' card on /dashboard and is sent to / from /leases. This is a UX redirect only. The services and routes re-check roles.

Dashboard range: the Malaysia month of now (toMytDate) and the 5 months before it. Month math is integer arithmetic on 'YYYY-MM'. Month labels are 'May 2026', built by hand without Intl. A 'This month' badge marks the current month.
orgId for the slip path comes from loadCaller(userId).member.orgId. getLease has already proved the lease belongs to that org, so it is the lease's org. LeaseDto has no org id.
The page title ('A-12-3 - Aisyah Rahman') comes from listLeases(ctx).find(id), because getLease returns only ids. This costs one extra query. Falls back to 'Lease'.

Record-payment form sends an optional Idempotency-Key header (crypto.randomUUID(), kept in a ref, cleared after success). The brief makes it optional (D9). It makes a double click a replay and not a second payment.

Received-at default is computed in a useEffect after mount as new Date(Date.now()+8h).toISOString().slice(0,16). It carries a justified eslint-disable for react-hooks/set-state-in-effect. Input is converted with mytLocalToIso.

Client validation: amount must parse with parseRinggitToSen, be a safe integer and be greater than 0 (else 'Enter an amount like 1,500.00' or 'The amount must be greater than zero.'). Slip must be JPEG, PNG or PDF, 5 MiB or less. Cash never sends slipPath.
On failure after upload: the server removes the slip. The client also tries storage.remove, which the browser role may refuse (no DELETE policy, D50) and which is ignored.

View slip opens about:blank synchronously inside the click (popup-blocker safe, opener = null), then sets its location to the signed URL. If the tab was blocked it shows a toast with an 'Open slip' action.
The slip button shows for every bank_transfer payment (any status). Approve / Reject show only for pending_verification and Void only for approved, and only when the caller is a manager.
Reject and Void both use an AlertDialog with a reason textarea (at least 5 trimmed characters, inline error). Approve has no dialog and goes straight to the toast.

Payment 'received at' is the DTO's ISO string, parsed with parseInstantWithOffset and shown with formatMytDisplay. Calendar dates are rendered as the stored 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings. Periods use an en dash ('2026-01-31 – 2026-02-27').
Lease search (?q=) is a plain GET form filtering unit and tenant names case-insensitively on the server. Search is not paginated.

t12.task: T12 tenant portal UI and payment return page (R31, R51, R52)
checks_run: npx tsc --noEmit: clean
npx eslint on the new files --max-warnings=0: clean
curl /tenant and /payments/return?bill_id=x without a session: 307 redirect to /login
Authenticated curl (session cookie for aisyah@northwind.test): /tenant 200 with the loading skeleton in the HTML; /payments/return with an unknown uuid 200 'Bill not found'

Authenticated /payments/return with Aisyah's real paid bill and paid=false in the URL: 200 'Payment received. Thank you.' with RM 6,274.19, so the page shows the DB status and ignores the paid parameter
The six PostgREST queries the portal runs, sent as Aisyah's JWT: row shapes match the zod schemas (bigint arrives as a number, dates as YYYY-MM-DD, received_at as an ISO string)
Not run: Pay now POST and phone save in a real browser. No browser was available, and the API route and the update were not exercised end to end so as not to change seeded data.
assumptions: No conflict with the kit rules; SPEC.md and the brief overrides were followed. getGatewayBill already existed in src/server/services/gateway.ts, so I did not have to wait for T7.

The tenant page is a server shell plus a client component. The (app) layout supplies the login redirect; RLS decides what data appears. A logged-in non-tenant (e.g. a manager) sees 'No tenancy found' because RLS returns no rows; the page does not redirect them.
Related tables are fetched as separate flat queries and joined on the client (units by unit_id), rather than a PostgREST embed. This avoids relying on composite-FK embedding.
Server rows are validated with zod in the browser, so a bad shape shows an error card instead of crashing. This adds zod to the client bundle.

Phone validation reuses the tenants.phone DB CHECK regex ^\+?[0-9][0-9 -]{5,19}$ on the trimmed value. This matches the task text (digits, spaces, dashes, optional leading +, 6-20 characters). An empty value is rejected on the client even though the DB allows null.
If the phone update returns zero rows (RLS blocked it), the UI shows an error toast rather than success.

Amount due now is Σ max(amount − paid, 0) over invoices with dueDate <= toMytDate(now), computed on the client. It ignores pending manual payments, as the SPEC says for R30. The server recomputes the real amount when the bill is created.

'now' is set only after the data loads on the client, and the server HTML contains only a skeleton, so there are no hydration differences (R52). Payment times use formatMytDisplay, which builds the string by hand with no Intl. Dates are shown as the raw YYYY-MM-DD strings.
If one tenant account has several tenant rows or leases, each gets its own card or section. Each lease shows its own Pay now, bill card, invoices and payments.
The bill card shows the simulator command and a link to /payments/return?bill_id=<id>&paid=true, as specified. The page ignores the paid parameter.

The return page redirects to /login if there is no session, even though the layout already does this, because it needs the user id. Missing bill_id, a malformed id, a nonexistent bill and another tenant's bill all show 'Bill not found' (HTTP 200, not a 404 status). Staff and managers of the lease's org can also view a bill there, because getGatewayBill allows it.
A Refresh status button (router.refresh) appears only for pending bills. It re-reads the DB and writes nothing.
Pay now errors: 422 shows the toast 'Nothing is due'. Other errors show the API's { error } message. A network failure shows 'Could not reach the server'.
Uses only existing components in src/components/ui (card, table, badge, button, input, label, skeleton, sonner). No new packages are needed.
t12.notes: To see the screens: log in at /login as aisyah@northwind.test, ben@northwind.test or probe@northwind.test (password RentDemo#2026), then open /tenant. Aisyah already has a paid bill (e70541f2-810c-45db-b5d4-cc871156dad3, from earlier tests), so open /payments/return?bill_id=e70541f2-810c-45db-b5d4-cc871156dad3&paid=false to see the paid state. An unknown id shows 'Bill not found'. Pay now needs a lease with invoices due on or before today's Malaysia date that are not fully paid, such as Ben's or Probe's. Pay now writes a real pending bill to the DB. Staff and manager accounts have no tenancy and see 'No tenancy found'.
